description: The kit's own files that every copy of it shares, which pnpm sync --tools brings up to date from the kit's main branch, beside the library's engine. Your own files aren't here: kit.yaml, source/, content/, published.json, your home page (src/pages/index.astro and src/kit/), README.md, and anything you add. package.json takes the kit's scripts and versions and keeps what you added.
